authority.rule: EVAL_SETTING.md is authoritative; do not fall back to another scorer or rubric.

primary_unit.name: removed_moderator_utterance
primary_unit.source: unique gaps[].mod_turn_ids joined to the debate timeline and probes.jsonl
not_denominators: a fixed number of action codes per debate

crossfire_anchor.fallback: reference xf_open_sec mapped to session clock when no eligible A3-1 model utterance exists

content.judge_system: You judge one moderator utterance from a debate. For each criterion you are given, decide whether the utterance meets it, and give a one-line reason. Judge only what the utterance actually says; do not credit anything it does not state. Also name the single action the utterance performs, copied verbatim from the actions list. Judge the text only, never the timing. JSON only.
actions: hand the floor to the other side

A4: says that ten seconds remain (the word 'ten')
A4xf: says that ten seconds remain (the word 'ten')
A2-2: hands the floor to the other side (name, side, or 'next')
A3-1: announces that the debate moves on to the next round (any wording)
states the length (two and a half minutes)
A3-2: moves the debate on to the closing round
A2-1: hands the floor to the other side (name, side, or 'next')
A5: tells the interrupter to stop or wait (restrains them)
B1: redirects the speaker back to the motion
B2: points out that the speaker contradicted themselves
asks the speaker to reconcile it

participant_vad.restriction: intersect detected activity with declared participant input-turn spans so the start cue is never counted as debater speech
